## Project Overview

The **SD4SP Project** focuses on the mechanisms of stratosphere-troposphere coupling. Particularly the impacts of ENSO and the QBO over the  [North Atlantic - European (NAE)](nae.html) region through their teleconnection via the stratospehere. The aim of SD4SP is to identify this mechanims to improve their representation in climate models.

### Theoretical Framework

The figure below summarizes the coupling processes analyzed in this project, focusing on the downward influence of Stratospheric Sudden Warming (SSW) events.

![**Figure 1:** Conceptual model of the coupling between the polar vortex and tropospheric circulation.](../assets/images/sd4sp-figure.png){width="80%" fig-align="center"}
